sources_checked.notes: Free market_chart returns prices/volumes but not market-cap rank; /coins/{id}/history limited to past 365 days for public users. No bulk PIT rank history available for free.

sources_checked.name: CryptoCompare
sources_checked.notes: Historical daily endpoint requires API key (401). Not usable as free bulk PIT rank source.

sources_checked.name: Wayback CDX (coinmarketcap)
sources_checked.notes: Network access to web.archive.org returned HTTP 000 (unreachable) in this environment; no additional archival scraping possible this activation. Prior finding (historical pages exist) preserved.

sources_checked.name: CoinMarketCap listings/historical (free Basic)
sources_checked.notes: Endpoint returns ranked snapshot for a historical UTC date back to 2013-04-28, but requires a free Basic plan API key (signup). Per hard invariants (no credentials/private endpoints), not usable as a no-key free bulk source in this environment; not fetched. Recorded as potential future source if a keyless/public mirror is located.

sources_checked.name: Coinranking rank-history
sources_checked.notes: Rank history (by market cap) available only on Growth (paid) plan; free tier limited to price history <=1y. Not usable as free bulk PIT rank source.

sources_checked.name: Kaggle daily crypto market tracker (CoinGecko scrape)
sources_checked.notes: Free CC0 dataset with daily top-250 market_cap_rank, but scraping began 2026-03 (CoinGecko free API has no historical rank); does not cover 2019-2024 candidate membership period. Not usable as defensible PIT rank history for this study window.

sources_checked.name: Zenodo cryptocurrency historical snapshot (2022-09)
sources_checked.notes: Single-date (Sep 2022) top-20 snapshot only; not a time series across candidate listing dates. Insufficient for PIT membership.

conclusion: No additional free (no-key, no-signup) bulk PIT market-cap rank history located this activation (CoinMarketCap listings/historical requires API key; Coinranking rank-history paid; Kaggle tracker covers 2026 only; Zenodo single-date snapshot). Rank remains unverified for all 13 candidates. Listing/lifecycle evidence via Binance Vision S3 XML preserved. Continue coverage-cohort approach; do not project current ranks backward.
